messages:
Anya: Quick sync — proposing a v2/v3 FlashAttention integration plan. Focus areas: kernel selection heuristics, batching thresholds, KV cache interaction (paged-attn fallback), and perf-regression safety nets. TL;DR: start 5% canary -> 20% ramp over 3 days, auto-fallback to v2 if p95 regresses >15% for 1h. Any objections?
Kevin: +1. Can we gate by seq_len distribution and batch_size? Suggest routing rule: prefer v3 for seq <= 2048 && batch <= 8, else stick to v2.
Sam: ran a quick nightly sweep; saw a p99 spike for long contexts with v3 when KV miss rate > ~30%. Raw numbers below.
Sam: ```
model: redwood-alpha-3
seq=4096 batch=4 kv_miss=0.35
v2: p95=82ms p99=140ms
v3: p95=95ms p99=210ms
```
Maria: that matches what I saw in kernel traces — v3's tiled kernels increase transient working set. With paged-attn fallback we end up doing extra copies on KV misses which hurts latency.
Anya: good to know. Proposed feature flags for canary rollout:
- attn_kernel="v3" (default off)
- attn_kernel.v3.paged_prefetch=true|false
- attn_kernel.v3.kv_threshold=0.3  # percent miss above which we favor v2
- attn_kernel.fallback_policy="auto-rollto-v2"
Kevin: can we expose kv_miss_rate and kernel.eviction_count as realtime metrics? Alert rule: kv_miss_rate > 0.25 AND p95 > baseline*1.10 -> rollback.
perf-bot: [ALERT] 2951234500 token-latency-regression detected: p95 +18% vs baseline for redwood-alpha-3 (canary group).
Sam: saw the alert. Looks isolated to us-west-2-gpu-pool-3. Repro steps I used below.
Sam: ```
# repro
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-3","seq":4096,"batch":4}'
# gather traces via /debug/trace endpoint
```
Kevin: ops, can you drain that pool from canary and flip attn_kernel=v3 off for that pool while we triage?
ops: started draining us-west-2-gpu-pool-3. Redirecting new canary traffic to us-east-1/gpu-pool-2. Flipping flag off on the affected pool now. :white_check_mark:
Maria: parallel suggestion: try a paged_prefetch experiment (prefetch KV pages for predicted next requests) to reduce misses; also micro-bench v3 with quantized kernels to see memory working set impact.
Anya: actions: 
- Sam: run microbench across seq=[256,1024,4096] and kv_miss in [0.0,0.2,0.35], collect p95/p99 and memory pressure (EOD).
- Kevin: implement routing rule (prefer v3 when seq <= 2048 && kv_miss < 0.3). PR + telemetry by EOD tomorrow.
- Ops: keep v3 off on us-west-2-pool-3, let canary continue in other pools.
- Maria: run paged_prefetch toggle experiments and quantized-kernel bench; report perf/ram delta.
We'll reconvene 9:30am PST tomorrow. If perf-bot fires again tag @Anya @Kevin @Maria. Thanks all :rocket:
Kevin: noted — will open FF rollout PR and add the kv_miss metric to the request tracing schema.
Sam: starting bench runs now, logging to /mnt/benchmarks/2951234567/ and pushing artifacts to the bench bucket.
Anya: great. If you hit an unexplained regression, dump a small flamegraph and paste link here. End of thread.
